_comment: Verified specification for the JYR8010-150W. This file exists mainly to correct a misreading of the parent report's metadata that produced wrong answers early in the 2026-09-05 session.

transformer.note: The parent report's metadata says '1:49 / 1:64'; vendor documentation says 1:64.

THE_CORRECTION._comment: Read this before trusting any earlier analysis in this repo.
THE_CORRECTION.misreading: The parent README at ../README.md says 'The antenna is a 40-meter end-fed half-wave design' and ../data/measurement_metadata.json says radiating_element_length_m: 40. This was initially read as a 40-METRE-BAND EFHW (about 20 m of wire).
THE_CORRECTION.reality: It means 40 METRES OF WIRE. It is an 80 m band EFHW. Every other band is a harmonic of the 80 m fundamental.
proof: Best measured match is 80 m at 3.605570 MHz with Z = 49.8 + 4.3j - a genuine resistive fundamental, not a harmonic.
Half-wave at 3.6056 MHz = 41.57 m; x 0.96 velocity factor = 39.9 m, matching the vendor's 39.6 m.
Measured minima 7.198 / 14.245 / 21.007 / 28.467 MHz are the 2nd / 4th / 6th / 8th harmonics with the normal progressive downshift.
THE_CORRECTION.consequence: Any half-wave length calculation that assumes a 7.15 MHz fundamental is wrong for this antenna. The first two answers given in the 2026-09-05 session made exactly this error and were retracted.

current_and_voltage_nodes_m_from_feed._comment: Critical for support placement and insulator selection. On an EFHW BOTH ends are voltage maxima.
current_and_voltage_nodes_m_from_feed.design_consequence: Support 3 was deliberately placed at 29.7 m of wire because that point is a current maximum on BOTH 40 m and 15 m. The apex support lands at 17.86 m of wire, close to the 19.8 m VOLTAGE maximum - so the apex needs the best insulator on the antenna, not just the ends.

measured_resonances_from_parent_report._comment: From ../README.md and ../data/. Captured 2026-08-16 12:50 PDT with NO ground and NO counterpoise, at unrecorded height. Not a free-space reference and not the installed configuration.
measured_resonances_from_parent_report.instrument: NanoVNA-H fw 1.2.50, 1.8-148 MHz, 40001 points, 1 kHz BW, 50 ohm ref

predicted_installed_resonances._comment: PREDICTION ONLY - must be verified by sweeping after installation.
predicted_installed_resonances.expected_shift: 1-2% downward once a counterpoise is fitted and the antenna is up at height
predicted_installed_resonances.action: Re-sweep with the NanoVNA after installation and add the result to ../measurements/ following the parent report's conventions.
